meta.source: Ministry of Education, UDISE+, via MoSPI eSankhyiki
meta.vintageNote: The MoSPI eSankhyiki response does not publish a data revision timestamp. Its archive capture date is recorded separately and must not be treated as the source revision date.
meta.revisionPolicy: These published administrative counts and survey estimates may be revised by the agency; changed responses are archived before rebaking.
meta.coverage: Proportion of Enrolments to Total Enrolments (Pre-Primary to Higher Secondary): all published cross-tabs; social group, state
meta.note: Complete observed row grain from data/raw/profiles-mospi/udise-0-15.json. No Cartesian expansion or averaging of state ratios. Existing school structure. Earlier institution-level collection and student-level collection are separate bundles. Pre-primary excludes standalone Anganwadis; source zero GER cells without a usable estimate are null; other reported zeros remain source values. Source ratios may exceed 100 where counts and population bases differ.
